transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net mobile customer care, my name is Lewis. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Lewis, my name is Grace Mitchell. My mobile phone has completely stopped getting any signal inside my home, dropping from 4G down to 'No Service' as soon as I walk through the front door!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good afternoon Grace. I can check your regional mast coverage and cellular network provisioning. Before we access your handset profile, could you confirm your full postal address and your account security PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is 29 St Mary's Road, Southampton, SO14 0AH, and my security PIN is 3819. My handset model is a Samsung Galaxy S23 with mobile number 07700 900619.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Grace, that confirms your account details. When did the indoor signal drop to No Service begin?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It started four days ago when local council roadworks began digging on the main avenue near our street because having a reliable home broadband connection is absolutely essential for our daily household work.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Bear with me for a couple of minutes while I check our cell mast telemetry and base station alarms in the SO14 postal sector in accordance with our standard telecommunications network diagnostic procedures.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for waiting, Grace. The local sector mast on St Mary's Road has an active power fault following council utility cable strikes, operating on emergency low power so that your account records and provisioning parameters remain completely up to date.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I am a community NHS midwife on night triage call this entire week! Pregnant mothers in active labor phone my mobile number directly when emergencies happen! If my phone drops to No Service indoors, I could miss a critical maternity delivery call! It could literally be life-threatening! I am beside myself with anxiety because having a reliable home broadband connection is absolutely essential for our daily household work.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Local cellular mast power repairs are managed by regional telecommunications grid engineers with an estimated fix time of seventy-two hours to maintain optimal throughput and low latency across the regional distribution network.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Seventy-two hours is completely useless when I have babies due tonight, Lewis! What can be done right now on my phone so I can receive incoming hospital calls inside my house so I really appreciate you taking the time to look into these technical details with me today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You need to activate S-Net Wi-Fi Calling on your smartphone to route voice calls across your home broadband wireless router in accordance with our standard telecommunications network diagnostic procedures.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How do I set that up on my Samsung Galaxy since we depend heavily on this service for remote working and family communications every day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously modern 5G handsets support seamless voice over Wi-Fi when cellular signal drops below minimum reception thresholds across all your connected household devices including laptops, mobile phones, and streaming hardware.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please just guide me through the settings menu so I know it is working because having a reliable home broadband connection is absolutely essential for our daily household work.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Open the 'Phone' app on your Samsung, tap the three dots in the top right corner, and select 'Settings' to ensure your S-Net service operates reliably without unexpected dropped packets or connection faults.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Tapped Phone, three dots, Settings. I see Call Settings so I really appreciate you taking the time to look into these technical details with me today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Scroll down to 'Wi-Fi Calling' and switch the toggle from OFF to ON so that your account records and provisioning parameters remain completely up to date.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Toggling Wi-Fi Calling to ON... It says 'Enabling Wi-Fi Calling service with S-Net...' since we depend heavily on this service for remote working and family communications every day.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Lewis, I am trembling with panic right now! If an emergency triage labor call comes through and drops, I will never forgive myself! Please make sure this connects so I really appreciate you taking the time to look into these technical details with me today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: A small telephone receiver icon with a Wi-Fi wave should appear in your top status notification bar to ensure your S-Net service operates reliably without unexpected dropped packets or connection faults.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Looking at the top bar... Yes! A little telephone handset icon with a Wi-Fi symbol just appeared next to the Wi-Fi fan!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now let us set the Wi-Fi Calling preference to prioritize Wi-Fi whenever you are connected to your home network.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Tapped on Wi-Fi Calling... I see 'Calling preference'. Selected 'Wi-Fi preferred'.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now let us execute a test call right now to verify voice quality across your broadband router.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will dial my husband's phone in the living room... Ringing now... He picked up! Sound is crystal clear!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That confirms voice calls and SMS text messages are routing seamlessly over your home Wi-Fi network.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What a massive relief! My NHS maternity labor calls will come straight through to my handset now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our automated network operations centre will send an SMS alert once the local cell mast repairs complete.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will be helpful so I know when standard outdoor cellular coverage is restored.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wi-Fi Calling requires no additional subscription charges on your S-Net unlimited tariff.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It is reassuring that all calls remain included in my standard allowance.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You can also verify that emergency 999 calling routes your registered home address over Wi-Fi Calling.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is vital for our home safety during the cellular outage.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The handset will automatically switch back to 5G cellular once you step outside your front door.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That handover between Wi-Fi and mobile data will be very smooth.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Remember to keep your home Wi-Fi router powered on continuously overnight.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I always leave the router switched on in the hallway.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The router's 5 gigahertz frequency band provides optimal voice latency for clear audio.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The audio sounded completely natural when I spoke to my husband.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What was that mobile handset model again?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: As I told you right at the start of the call, it is a Samsung Galaxy S23.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have updated your device profile with the Samsung Galaxy S23 model code.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, that ensures device compatibility is noted.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Before we conclude our call, that mobile phone number was 07700 900619, correct?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We have identified the local mast outage, activated Wi-Fi Calling on your Samsung S23, verified incoming call routing, and confirmed voice clarity.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Everything is working smoothly now. Thank you Lewis.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there any other aspect of your mobile plan or reception I can help you with today, Grace?
